newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 10.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 10.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
Pajaritos crude port reopened at 1000 local/1600 GMT Saturday after shutting last Thursday at 2100 local/0300 GMT. A port captain said winds were calm at 20 to 30 km per hour.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Warm temperatures with maximum winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour) and waves three to seven feet high. -- Gulf of Mexico:
Cold air above north Chihuahua state and possible rains in northeast gulf region, south of Veracruz, Tabasco and the Yucatan peninsula. Clear skies along rest of coast with winds 10 to 15 knots.
Warm partly cloudy with moderate southeastern winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
